notes.title: The Beast Is Yet To Come – Demo Launches September 15th
notes.content: [p]On [b]September 15th[/b], the first [b]playable demo[/b] of [i]The Beast Is Yet To Come[/i] will be unleashed on Steam.[/p][p]This demo gives you an early taste of the game’s brutal roguelike action and its mysterious atmosphere:[/p][list][*][p][b]Challenging Combat[/b] – Master your fight style and adapt to punishing encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Replayability[/b] – Every run brings new strategies, enemies, and surprises.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unfolding Mystery[/b] – Each death isn’t an end, but another step toward revealing the truth about the Beast.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is only the beginning. The Beast waits for you… but how long can you survive?[/p][p][b]Demo live September 15th on Steam[/b] – Don’t forget to [b]Wishlist now[/b] so you don’t miss the release.[/p]
